monetization.noteEs: Early Access pago lanzado el 14 de abril de 2026 (~$18-20 USD). Sin microtransacciones ni cosméticos pagos: compras el juego y todo el contenido futuro de la Early Access está incluido. Kraken Express no ha anunciado un modelo distinto para el lanzamiento 1.0.
monetization.noteEn: Paid Early Access launched April 14, 2026 (~$18-20 USD). No microtransactions or paid cosmetics: you buy the game and all future Early Access content is included. Kraken Express hasn't announced a different model for the 1.0 launch.
